summary: Per-frame vehicle input processor. For each axis (throttle, brake, clutch, steering, handbrake) it either copies a direct target value when the mode field == 2, or ramps a smoothed accumulator toward 1.0 / 0.0 using a per-axis decay constant times the input scalar a2 times 10.0, clamped to the float 1.0 / 0.0 bit patterns. Steering adds a sign-aware return-to-center ramp gated by an input-active flag and a neutral flag. Writes the six smoothed outputs back through output pointers a3 (steering), a4 (throttle), a5 (brake), a6 (clutch), a7 (handbrake), a8 (gear). The gear output is selected from a ladder of seven gear-input flags (reverse -1, gears 1..7) gated by a byte flag at this+0x2428 and a neutral override at 0x20F0 == 0, with a global byte_7D1370 == 1 forcing neutral. Called per frame from VehicleMainPhysicsUpdate and CollisionConfigurationSync.

local_names.v16: steering neutral-flag value read from this+0x1BC8

operations.description: Throttle mode gate: if this+0x1B20 == 2 (guard:0) take the direct-passthrough path, bypassing the smoothing ramp.
Throttle direct target: this+0x2410 (float) = this+0x1B48.
Throttle decay step: v8 = flt_7D12C8 * a2 * 10.0.
Throttle input-active check: if this+0x1B44 is nonzero the throttle ramps upward, otherwise it decays.
Throttle ramp up: this+0x2410 (float) += v8; if the result exceeds 1.0 force the dword 1065353216 (float 1.0 bit pattern).
Throttle decay: if this+0x1B70 is nonzero subtract v8 * 1.5 from this+0x2410, else subtract v8; if the result is below 0.0 force the dword 0.
Commit throttle output: *a4 = this+0x2410.
Brake mode gate: if this+0x1B4C == 2 (guard:1) take the direct-passthrough path.
Brake direct target: this+0x2414 (float) = this+0x1B74.
Brake decay step: v10 = flt_7D12EC * a2 * 10.0.
Brake input-active check: if this+0x1B70 is nonzero the brake ramps upward, otherwise it decays.
Brake ramp up: this+0x2414 (float) += v10; clamp above 1.0 to dword 1065353216.
Brake decay: this+0x2414 (float) -= v10; clamp below 0.0 to dword 0.
Commit brake output: *a5 = this+0x2414.
Clutch mode gate: if this+0x21D4 == 2 (guard:6) take the direct-passthrough path.
Clutch direct target: this+0x2418 (float) = this+0x21FC.
Clutch decay step: v13 = flt_7D12EC * a2 * 10.0.
Clutch input-active check: if this+0x21F8 is nonzero the clutch ramps upward, otherwise it decays.
Clutch ramp: if active this+0x2418 (float) += v13 with a 1.0 clamp (dword 1065353216); else this+0x2418 -= v13 with a 0.0 clamp.
Commit clutch output: *a6 = this+0x2418.
Steering direct gate: if this+0x1B78 == 2 AND this+0x1BA4 == 2 (guards:2 and 3) copy the steering target directly and skip the smoothing ramp.
Steering direct value: if float this+0x1BA0 <= 0.0 then this+0x241C = float this+0x1BCC, else this+0x241C = -(float this+0x1BA0); then jump to the steering commit label.
Steering decay step: v17 = flt_7D12A4 * a2 * 10.0; snapshot current steering v19 = float this+0x241C and its sign flags v20 (negative) / v22 (zero).
Steering input-active check: if this+0x1B9C is nonzero the steering is being driven by input; otherwise it returns toward center.

Steering ramp while input active and neutral flag clear: if this+0x1BC8 (v16) == 0 and the current value is positive, subtract 3.0 * v17 then v17, clamping below -1.0 to dword -1082130432 (float -1.0 bit pattern).
Steering return-to-center while input inactive and neutral flag set: if this+0x1BC8 (v16) != 0 and the current value is negative, add 3.0 * v17 then v17, clamping above 1.0 to dword 1065353216.

Steering fallthrough ramp: when input is active with the neutral flag set, or inactive without it, apply a sign-dependent v17 ramp toward zero; when the accumulator crosses its sign boundary force this+0x241C = 0. The ramp direction is chosen by a decompiler FPU-status flag (v24 & 0x41) whose origin is ambiguous (see unresolved).
Commit steering output: *a3 = this+0x241C.
Gear-selection gate: the gear ladder only runs when byte this+0x2428 is nonzero.
Gear ladder init: this+0x2424 = -2; if this+0x20F0 == 0 (guard:5) the ladder chooses a gear from the gear-input flags, otherwise this+0x2424 = 7.

Gear-flag ladder (descending if/else chain): this+0x20C4 set -> gear 6; this+0x2098 -> 5; this+0x206C -> 4; this+0x2040 -> 3; this+0x2014 -> 2; this+0x1FE8 -> 1; this+0x1FBC -> reverse -1; none set leaves the initial -2.
Gear neutral override: if this+0x2424 still == -2 (dword 0xFFFFFFFE, guard:7) and global byte_7D1370 == 1, force this+0x2424 = 0 (neutral).
Commit gear output: *a8 = this+0x2424.
Handbrake mode gate: if this+0x1C54 == 2 (guard:4) take the direct-passthrough path.
Handbrake direct target: this+0x2420 (float) = this+0x1C7C; *a7 = this+0x2420 and return.
Handbrake engage: if this+0x1C78 is nonzero set this+0x2420 = dword 1065353216 (float 1.0), write *a7 = same.
Handbrake decay: v29 = float this+0x2420 - flt_7D1310 * a2 * 10.0; if >= 0.0 commit and *a7 = this+0x2420, else set this+0x2420 = 0 and *a7 = 0.

unresolved: Six read-only globals (0x0059E43C, 0x0059E440, 0x0059E478, 0x0059E5FC, 0x0059E670, 0x0059E8A4) appear in the fact table as read but Hex-Rays folds them into FPU instructions, so they never appear as named references in the .c.

The steering fallthrough branch tests (v24 & 0x41) on the decompiler artifact char v18 (an FPU status byte carried over from a prior compare); its origin is unverifiable in the .c, so the exact ramp direction in that path is ambiguous.

The float bit-pattern dword literals 1065353216 (1.0f) and -1082130432 (-1.0f) are preserved as written; the gear-field semantics (which of this+0x1FBC/0x1FE8/0x2014/0x2040/0x206C/0x2098/0x20C4 maps to which gear) come from the fills' DERIVED naming, not from the .c.
